## Publication Information

**Date:** 1847

**Genre:** Fiction (modern)

**Publisher:** James Burns, Portman Street; London; Henry Mozley and Sons, Derby.

**Notes:** The Mohun family appear in the later novels <i>Beechcroft at Rockstone </i>and <i>The Two Sides of the Shield.</i>
